name: tree-sitter-ncl
description: Tree-sitter grammar prototype for NCAR Command Language

scripts.test:editor: mkdir -p .cache/state/nvim && XDG_STATE_HOME="$PWD/.cache/state" nvim --headless -u NONE -i NONE -l test/editor.lua
scripts.test:lazy: mkdir -p .cache/state/nvim && XDG_CACHE_HOME="$PWD/.cache" XDG_STATE_HOME="$PWD/.cache/state" nvim --headless -u NONE -i NONE -l test/lazy.lua
scripts.test:blink: mkdir -p .cache/state/nvim && XDG_STATE_HOME="$PWD/.cache/state" nvim --headless -u NONE -i NONE -l test/blink.lua
scripts.check:editor: npm run check && npm run test:editor && npm run test:blink && npm run test:lazy
scripts.check: npm run generate && npm run test && npm run test:examples && npm run build && npm run test:neovim
